verdict.rationale: Brex publishes developer docs and a quickstart guide for making API calls (brex-docs-5), implying some interactive onboarding, but there is no direct evidence of a runnable, in-browser API reference (e.g., try-it-now console); probes for standard OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints all returned 404, suggesting no conventional interactive spec-driven reference. Missing for 10: explicit interactive 'try it' console, runnable code snippets, or a working OpenAPI/Swagger UI confirming live API exploration.
